title: Chizkiyah, Father of Ikesh
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bekhorot 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bekhorot.38a.3), testifying before Rabban Gamliel at Yavneh in the name of Rabban Gamliel the Elder. So also in the [Sifra, Shemini 129 (section 7:4 in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Sifra%2C_Shemini%2C_Section_7.4); [the Yalkut there, remez 539](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Torah.539.2), reads Chizkiyah of Ikesh. Hyman suggests that possibly it is a place-name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Bekhorot has “Chizkiyah, father of Ikesh.” The linked Yalkut has “Chizkiyah of Ikesh” and retains Rabban Gamliel the Elder in the testimony. Hyman proposes that Ikesh may be a place.
The linked Sifra also says “father of Ikesh.” Its Hebrew does not name the Elder in this sentence, although the linked English translation supplies him.
